page_title: RAY 1-2 GIR | Rayo Vallecano v Girona 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Jorge de Frutos finds some space and receives a very precise long pass from Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
90+3' Rayo Vallecano are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
90+1' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) brings an opponent down and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes interrupts the game.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

87' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Paulo Gazzaniga and his nice save.
87' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
85' Here is a change. Ivan Martin is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Valery (Girona).
84' Michel is forced to make a change. Savio is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Portu (Girona).
84' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
83' Savio (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
82' Yan Couto (Girona) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
82' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano), but it's just wide of the right post.
82' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will deliver the corner kick.
80' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
80' Girona will take a corner kick.
78' It's time for a substitution. Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) comes on in place of Alvaro Garcia.
78' Substitution. Andrei Ratiu will be replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
78' Michel has decided to substitute Viktor Tsygankov and he is replaced by Yan Couto (Girona).
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) for Artem Dovbyk.
76' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
76' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Girona.
73' Ivan Martin (Girona) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
72' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
71' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
67' Francisco has decided to make a change. Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Unai Lopez.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergio Camello leaves the pitch and Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
65' 1 - 2 Goal! Savio (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:2.
65' Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a great save to deny Artem Dovbyk (Girona) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
65' A pass from Savio (Girona) is intercepted by Stole Dimitrievski and the move breaks down.
64' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
63' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows the whistle, Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is penalised for a foul.
59' The substitution is prepared. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oscar Trejo.
58' Half-chance! Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) plays a pass into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga reacts well to snuff out the attack.
57' A crossfield pass from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates.
56' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
55' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the crossbar and is cleared to safety.
54' 9:14 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.

54' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rayo Vallecano.
53' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

53' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Paulo Gazzaniga is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rayo Vallecano.
51' The attendance for today's match is 13177.
50' A cross from a corner kick by Girona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

48' Rayo Vallecano are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' A decent cross gives Yangel Herrera (Girona) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is able to continue to play.
45+4' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+3' The game is interrupted now, Yangel Herrera (Girona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+2' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Girona are ruled offside.
44' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.

42' 1 - 1 Goal! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Viktor Tsygankov inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:1.
42' The ball is cleared after Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
41' A pass by Artem Dovbyk (Girona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

38' A neat pass is well received by Ivan Martin (Girona), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
37' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
34' One of the Girona players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
34' Rayo Vallecano are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
32' Savio (Girona) and Miguel Gutierrez combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
30' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
29' Savio picks out Artem Dovbyk (Girona) on the edge of the six-yard box, but the headed attempt bends just round the right post.
28' Savio (Girona) takes a short free kick.
27' A player from Rayo Vallecano takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

27' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
25' A long pass, executed by Savio (Girona), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
25' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
24' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle as Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
23' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stole Dimitrievski intercepts the ball.
22' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
21' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
17' Alfonso Espino swings the cross over. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.
16' Rayo Vallecano keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
15' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
14' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) receives a yellow card!
12' The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
11' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

9' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.

5' 1 - 0 Isi Palazon passes the ball into the penalty area. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom right corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
4' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
4' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' It's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano in a dangerous position.
2' Savio (Girona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes will officiate today.
